Chapter 195: 0192 The Lavishness of a Whale Player

Outside the southwest gate of Tsinghua University.

This place had already replaced Peking University's south gate as Chen Guiliang's first choice for barbecue skewers.

It was next to the Tsinghua dormitory area, with numerous barbecue stalls. It was also very close to Chen Guiliang's company, and many employees from Bytedance and Youke rented apartments nearby.

On Friday, Chen Guiliang, Bian Guanyue, Xie Yang, Wu Meng, and Yang Shuo, five old classmates or folks from the same hometown, gathered together and went for skewers outside Tsinghua's southwest gate.

How to describe Yang Shuo's learning ability?

He learned hands-on tasks quickly, but things that required using his brain came a bit slower.

When Game Science expanded its staff, they bought a new Jinbei van. Chen Guiliang simply threw Yang Shuo over to Youke to be a driver.

At this moment, Yang Shuo was eating skewers while observing the street, always feeling that someone had ill intentions and that he could step forward to protect Chen Guiliang.

This was mainly because of a major incident that happened in Wangfujing last month.

A migrant worker who collected scrap had been living a very difficult life. He finally learned to operate a forklift, and his monthly salary reached over 3,000 yuan, turning him into a "successful person."

But the factory was heavily polluted and was forced to shut down.

Not only did this migrant worker lose his job, but he was also owed wages he couldn't collect. Even with the intervention of the labor department, he only received 703 yuan, which was far from settling his full salary.

He deliberately chose September 11th, took a taxi to Wangfujing with a sharp knife in his pocket. He first killed the taxi driver, then drove the car down the street, hitting people...

After the news report, Yang Shuo felt that Beijing wasn't so safe anymore and worried that Chen Guiliang, with his net worth of over a hundred million, might be targeted by criminals.

"The new server for *Reign Over the World* opens tonight. Brother Gang must be really busy over there," Xie Yang clinked glasses with Chen Guiliang. "After all, I worked there for half a year, and this game has my blood and sweat in it. I'm planning to log in and play tonight."

Chen Guiliang smiled and said, "Don't get sucked in by spending money."

"I'm not a kid anymore." Xie Yang felt he had already matured.

Wu Meng asked, "Who's Brother Gang?"

Xie Yang looked at Chen Guiliang, who gave a slight nod.

Only then did Xie Yang say, "A small-time boss from Longdu. When Chen Daxia was in his third year of high school, he gave Brother Gang an idea, so Brother Gang sold his family property to make a game. Last week, the game went online and it's been a huge hit."

"Third year of high school?" Wu Meng looked at Chen Guiliang. "You're really something."

Bian Guanyue asked, "Is that the game company you helped me invest in?"

Chen Guiliang nodded, "Yeah."

Hearing this, Wu Meng became even more envious of Bian Guanyue.

When she was in her third year of high school, her thoughts were exceptionally simple. Her mind was filled with getting into Peking University, having a romantic encounter by Weiming Lake, and then staying in Beijing with her lover, working, marrying, buying a house, having children, and living out her life.

Now, she had much more to consider.

Having such an outstanding old classmate like Chen Guiliang around, although he was her best friend's boyfriend and she couldn't do anything with him behind her friend's back, she always used Chen Guiliang as a benchmark to compare with other guys she met.

As a result, no guy could catch her eye.

Wu Meng asked, "The campus belle election week just ended. Did you retain your title as campus belle?"

"It's just the students voting randomly," Bian Guanyue said, then looked at Chen Guiliang.

Last year, when she was elected campus belle, Bian Guanyue found it troublesome as she wasn't used to being the center of so much attention. This year, however, she was quite happy. Retaining the title of campus belle at CUEB made Bian Guanyue feel that she was a better match for Chen Guiliang.

While studying hard, she also diligently taught herself music theory, hoping to write a popular internet song.

It seemed that only by achieving more could she avoid being left too far behind by Chen Guiliang.

"Xu Fengyin!"

Xie Yang suddenly stood up and waved.

Xu Fengyin was leading her two assistants, who were also her apprentices, along the street, looking for a late-night snack stall with empty seats. The place she rented was only a few hundred meters away.

"Wow, you're all here."

Xu Fengyin came over to say hello and even greeted Bian Guanyue proactively, "Hello, Boss's wife!"

"Hello. You know me?" Bian Guanyue asked.

"Of course I do. The boss's wife comes to the company often."

Xu Fengyin was a little embarrassed; she had secretly drawn sketches of Bian Guanyue before.

She loved drawing beautiful women and handsome men.

After a few words, she took her two apprentices and went to a nearby snack stall to sit down.

Wu Meng winked at Bian Guanyue, as if to say, this girl is gorgeous. Be careful!

Xie Yang's phone rang. He took it out, answered a call, and after hanging up said, "Zhang Liangying's commercial is finally done shooting."

After *Super Girl* finished airing, the "Super Girls" had many performances and events.

After a delay of more than a month, Zhang Liangying finally found the time to finish filming the advertisement and taking promotional photos for Kaixin001.

Just as Xie Yang hung up, Chen Guiliang's phone rang again.

Tao Chenggang said excitedly, "Over 46,000 concurrent users online, and the new server that opened tonight is almost full. The promotion team I put together only promoted it in the internet cafes in Hangzhou. And in Longdu, the internet cafes I sold before have all installed *Reign Over the World*. We haven't even started promoting in other places yet!"

"Is the game okay?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Tao Chenggang said, "Players have found some minor bugs, but no major issues. We did thorough prep work, and the game is very polished. If nothing unexpected happens, we can start the open beta next month."

This was mainly thanks to Chen Guiliang. He directly provided the framework and defined various features and gameplay mechanics. It allowed Tao Chenggang to avoid detours and be twice as effective when developing the game!

On Shi Yuzhu's side, however, even though the number of developers was constantly increasing, they went through all sorts of trials and revisions. Often, a new idea would come up, Shi Yuzhu would hold a meeting to discuss it, and after it was implemented, they would feel it wasn't good and continue with more meetings to discuss revisions. Sometimes, ideas were even scrapped entirely.

The development speed of *Zhengtu* was far slower than *Reign Over the World*.

Tao Chenggang said, "That old client of ours from the private server days is spending money like crazy this time. It's only been a week, and he's already thrown in over five thousand. When I have some time, I plan to treat him to a big meal."

"You should. Old friends should be taken care of," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

This old friend was, of course, Jing Ye Fu Guoqiang.

Fu Guoqiang was a spiritual shareholder of *Reign Over the World*. He had poured a lot of money into *Abyssal Legend* and had been closely following the development progress of Tao Chenggang's game.

A few months ago, he even asked Tao Chenggang if he needed donations.

"I won something good from the lottery!"

Fu Guoqiang typed furiously, showing off to his friends in the QQ group.

What good thing?

Of course, it was a manufacturing blueprint... for a level 40 orange-grade item.

Moreover, the manufacturing blueprint he got was for the foremost of the Ten Famous Swords—the Xuanyuan Sword.

Although it didn't match his current class, Fu Guoqiang decided to reset his stats for the Xuanyuan Sword and switch to a new class that corresponded with this sword.

After a round of showing off, Fu Guoqiang went to the in-game store to buy a trumpet and started spamming messages in the game: "Buying Copper of Mount Shou, Essence of Luo River... for Yuanbao or RMB at a high price."

He had Tao Chenggang's QQ number. After shouting in the game, he sent Tao Chenggang a QQ message: "Bro, around what level can you generally gather all these materials?"

Tao Chenggang quickly replied, "The purple-grade materials are relatively easy to get. But the five orange-grade materials can only drop from level 40 dungeons. And they drop from the level 40 dungeons of five different kingdoms. I won't specify which five, it's more fun to find out yourself."

"Level 40 dungeons, huh?" Fu Guoqiang was a bit disappointed, but also very expectant.

The harder the materials were to get, the more awesome the Xuanyuan Sword must be.

Tao Chenggang said, "The Ten Famous Swords are the top-tier weapons at level 40, and they can't be obtained directly from boss drops. Even the drop rate for their crafting materials isn't high. The orange-grade materials for each famous sword come from the level 40 dungeons of different kingdoms."

Fu Guoqiang asked again, "Can you get the materials from the lottery?"

"You can," Tao Chenggang reminded him, "but the chance of getting a level 40 orange-grade material from the lottery is even lower than getting a manufacturing blueprint for the Ten Famous Swords. I don't recommend trying to get them through the lottery."

"I'll try with a thousand yuan first."

"Hope you have fun."

Fu Guoqiang blew on his palms and then rubbed them together repeatedly, muttering under his breath.
